status: Source change passes focused available-renderer checks. Stable-release Android qualification remains open after one unexpected reboot. No claim that the reboot is fixed.
implementation: Skip original dome/sheet cubemap shading only when the owning Environment has no radiance consumers. Visible sky, quality choices, independent ground-shadow/reflection controls and the preceding 160-sample High change remain.
Unknown environments, reflections, sky ambient, aerial/volumetric fog and SDFGI conservatively retain complete sky. Same environment predicate as the existing volume-only guard.
Every update reevaluates the real owner, including menu and runtime transitions. No new setting, lower-quality approximation, cached sky or material ownership change.
scope: Private existing runtimes with explicit touched-source substitutions, not a full-current-source package, gameplay playthrough, Windows or original-report-device validation.

menu_substitutions: external script factory is an instance method returning self; canonical factory creates the same new class instance
fixture_changes: Consumer tests republish cloud globals after Off and prove enabled clouds alter visible output.
Compatibility aerial fog lacks material radiance sampling in drivers/gles3/shaders/scene.glsl:1982-1994; skip only its unsafe positive assertion, retain all policy/image checks.
Android progress fixture adds logging only; baseline replay removes whole-sky guard assertions and uses exact pre-change sky.

performance_claim.method: ABBA, 256 warmup +480 sampled frames per arm, same cloud clock, production-rate dome spin and actual old/new EISky.update calls. Mean of two medians each. Every timed clock poll is 587MHz.
performance_claim.limits: One current-source run plus preceding 6.32% moving-dome prototype. A roughly .57ms timing step occurs across both final-source arm pairs. Display remains 60Hz capped; this is isolated sky GPU cost, not FPS. Applies only where the sky cubemap is unused. Typical enhanced-water gameplay keeps sky reflections and does not take this skip.

completed_run_totals.limits: Includes superseded fixtures and diagnostics; compile/capability probes have no assertion count. Interrupted reboot has no completed result and is separate.

unexpected_reboot.before: Private Mobile consumer/menu validation; no per-stage progress in that first fixture.
unexpected_reboot.observed: Device disconnected and rebooted. Boot reason only reboot; kernel boot log reports MSM-controlled PS_HOLD shutdown. No prior kernel/fatal application stack recovered. Battery/thermal readings after reboot do not establish its cause.

recovery.kind: Recovery from transient ADB disconnect during validation; original runner aborted in cleanup before run.json

unexpected_reboot.decision: No more uncontrolled reboot reproduction loops. Retain as unresolved release-stability issue; qualify the complete final APK and collect stage/kernel logs if it recurs.

android_capability_correction.correction: Earlier handoff/quality receipt incorrectly described fallback as missing native alpha capability. The installed engine has ei_sky_subpass_alpha=true. Portability.constrained() is true on Android, so production policy deliberately selects sheet fallback. Native volume remains outside this validation; installing an engine with the same flag does not override platform policy.

new_release_authorization: User subsequently requested remaining costly-setting fixes followed by a new stable build, push and publication. Main thread only, no gameplay playthroughs. No publication/build done at this checkpoint.
